title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
Binance: BTC withdrawals confirmed live (CZ confirmed on X). FBI attributes $6.3B hack to N. Korea TraderTraitor group. Binance now covers 95% of stolen assets internally.
BTC ~$77,900 (+1% 24h) — no threshold breach.
Week ahead: ISM Mfg PMI Mon 10am ET, ISM Services Wed, NFP Fri (est. +55k).
